Write code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Option 2 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 3 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 4 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 5 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.ai.documentintelligence.models import AnalyzeResult, DocumentAnalysisFeature
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from typing import Dict, Any

def extract_expense_fields(document_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Extracts expense fields from a document using Azure Document Intelligence's
    prebuilt invoice model and normalizes them into a standard JSON schema.

    Args:
        document_path: The path to the document file (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG).

    Returns:
        A dictionary representing the normalized expense fields.
    """
    endpoint = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    key = os.environ.get("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")

    if not endpoint or not key:
        raise ValueError(
            "AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY "
            "environment variables must be set."
        )

    document_intelligence_client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(
        endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key)
    )

    with open(document_path, "rb") as f:
        poller = document_intelligence_client.begin_analyze_document(
            "prebuilt-invoice",
            f,
            content_type="application/octet-stream",  # Or specific content type like "application/pdf"
        )
        result: AnalyzeResult = poller.result()

    normalized_expense = {
        "vendor_name": None,
        "invoice_date": None,
        "total_amount": None,
        "total_currency": None,
        "line_items": [],
    }

    if result.documents:
        for doc in result.documents:
            if doc.doc_type == "invoice":
                fields = doc.fields
                
                vendor_name_field = fields.get("VendorName")
                if vendor_name_field and vendor_name_field.value:
                    normalized_expense["vendor_name"] = vendor_name_field.value

                invoice_date_field = fields.get("InvoiceDate")
                if invoice_date_field and invoice_date_field.value:
                    normalized_expense["invoice_date"] = invoice_date_field.value.isoformat()

                total_amount_field = fields.get("InvoiceTotal")
                if total_amount_field and total_amount_field.value:
                    normalized_expense["total_amount"] = total_amount_field.value
                    if total_amount_field.currency_symbol:
                        normalized_expense["total_currency"] = total_amount_field.currency_symbol
                    elif total_amount_field.unit: # sometimes currency is in unit
                        normalized_expense["total_currency"] = total_amount_field.unit

                line_items_field = fields.get("Items")
                if line_items_field and line_items_field.value:
                    for item in line_items_field.value:
                        item_fields = item.value
                        line_item = {
                            "description": None,
                            "quantity": None,
                            "unit_price": None,
                            "total_price": None,
                        }
                        
                        description_field = item_fields.get("Description")
                        if description_field and description_field.value:
                            line_item["description"] = description_field.value
                        
                        quantity_field = item_fields.get("Quantity")
                        if quantity_field and quantity_field.value:
                            line_item["quantity"] = quantity_field.value
                        
                        unit_price_field = item_fields.get("UnitPrice")
                        if unit_price_field and unit_price_field.value:
                            line_item["unit_price"] = unit_price_field.value
                        
                        total_price_field = item_fields.get("Amount")
                        if total_price_field and total_price_field.value:
                            line_item["total_price"] = total_price_field.value
                        
                        normalized_expense["line_items"].append(line_item)
                break # Assuming only one invoice per document for simplicity

    return normalized_expense<ctrl63>
